description: Assigned adoption at101 terminal stages; no global equilibrium optimum.

interpretation.endpoint_scope: Completed80-round runs only; stopped rows retained separately.
interpretation.cumulative_scope: Totals through stop retained for every run; only completed runs ranked together.
interpretation.local_scope: Adjacent declared grid points; stopped runs break neighborhoods. Edges labeled.
interpretation.cash_scope: No tail buffer draw is a last10-round diagnostic, not proof of stationary sustainability.
interpretation.uncertainty: No randomness or empirical probabilities in this grid.
interpretation.objective: Base-price gross GDP and worker consumption, not net income or welfare.

ai10.scope: Static inherited-capacity envelope with retained/redeployed labor and freely chosen task share. No claim of affordable demand, cash feasibility, profitable prices, long-run sustainability, net output, welfare or optimal investment.

ai25.scope: Static inherited-capacity envelope with retained/redeployed labor and freely chosen task share. No claim of affordable demand, cash feasibility, profitable prices, long-run sustainability, net output, welfare or optimal investment.
